owner_only: Extensions can only be installed, updated and removed on the hub machine (personad extension …) or in the hub’s admin page
market_only: This extension can only be installed, updated and removed on the hub machine (personad extension …) or in the hub’s admin page. From a phone you can only install extensions from a marketplace
node_confirm: This runs “{name}”’s program on this computer, as the node’s system user and outside a sandbox.
no_handoff_rule: There is no such hand-off rule.
